title: Scarborough murder suspect dies in hospital after police shooting
subtitle: SIU probes circumstances around Ricardo Miraballes' death
article: A 37-year-old man charged with first-degree murder in the death of Maryna Kudzianiuk has died in hospital, Ontario's Special Investigations Unit says.
Ricardo Miraballes died in hospital Feb. 3 following a Toronto police-involved shooting in Scarborough Jan. 18. The SIU is investigating the incident, the police watchdog said in a news release.

That day, officers were observing a man who was a "person of interest" in an investigation. Shortly after noon, officers in several unmarked vehicles proceeded to conduct a takedown of a red pickup truck being operated by a man on McCowan Road, south of Town Centre Court.
There was an interaction, and multiple officers opened fire, the SIU said. The man was struck multiple times and he was transported to hospital for treatment.
On Jan. 18, police arrested Miraballes and charged him with first-degree murder in the death of Kudzianiuk. Police announced the arrest Jan. 24.
Kudzianiuk, 49, was declared the city's third homicide victim of 2020 after she died in hospital following a fire Jan. 13.
It was around 3 a.m. that day when Toronto Fire Services responded to a call for a fire in an 18th floor unit at 25 Bay Mills Blvd., near Sheppard and Warden avenues.
Firefighters found the unit fully engulfed and extinguished the fire, but located Kudzianiuk suffering from serious injuries. She was taken to hospital where she later died.
Kudzianiuk was described by a family friend " as the most loving and caring person " they ever met.
The SIU is asking anyone who may have information about this investigation to contact the lead investigator at 1-800-787-8529.
